'''Gavos''' was a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was the location of a poorly productive [[oridium]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Bargos's mining operation|operation]] that was won in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by [[Bargos (Hutt)|Bargos]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]&mdash;a gambling, middle-ranked [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] living on hard times in a [[Bargos' Palace|palace]] somewhere on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Bargos called in a debt of obligation from a group of adventurers and had them travel to Gavos to assess the quality and worth of the mines.<ref name="Review" />

At Gavos they discovered that the mines technically contained tons of oridium, but that the ore was too difficult to extract to be profitable. However, the group also made a [[Gavos Droid Revolution|discovery on Gavos]] that resulted in a fight for their lives against unexpected enemies.<ref name="Review" />
